description: Figure 19 presents the average probing accuracy achieved using different Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) variations, with hidden layer sizes indicated in square brackets. The horizontal axis represents the probing target, labeled with terms such as “concat,” “embedding layer 0,” and “layer 1,” arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis represents the average probing accuracy, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, marked with tick labels at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100, and units expressed as a percentage (%).  There are 13 bars, each representing a different probing target. The bars vary in height, with the shortest bar corresponding to “concat” at approximately 13% and the tallest bar corresponding to “embedding layer 0” at approximately 82%.  The bars are not visually emphasized or grouped, and are arranged alphabetically by probing target.
